stops: TUR-SF-STOP 2N per unit from its own fill
TUR-SF-STOPADD +1/2 N for every earlier unit per add

rules.rule: unit = floor(0.01 x notional account / (N x dollars per point))
rules.derivation: equities: dollars per point = 1 per share, so a unit is floor(0.01 x notional / N) whole shares; N is the value at the prior close (no same-day information)

rules.rule: size from a notional account; every 10 % drawdown of the current notional cuts it by 20 %, until the yearly start is regained
rules.derivation: Dennis set the yearly notional account subjectively; the adaptation uses actual equity at the first session of each year (as PR #779 / #705); cuts compound per the printed example (1.0 -> 0.8 -> 0.64)

rules.rule: at most 4 units per market (per security)
at most 12 units long (and 12 short)
rules.derivation: long-only adaptation: only the 12-unit long limit can bind

rules.rule: at most 6 units in closely and 10 in loosely correlated markets per direction
rules.reason: the engine enforces both limits whenever a point-in-time group provider is supplied (sf-turtle-1.1.0). The binding is DATA_BLOCKED: the groups are futures market groups; for equities they need point-in-time industry membership or a declared correlation measure. The snapshot has neither (SEC SIC in the repository is CURRENT_ONLY, sic-peer-taxonomy-v1 backtestEligible false), and choosing a correlation threshold would add an unsourced parameter. Research runs therefore report correlationLimits NOT_EVALUATED_NO_PIT_GROUPS. Supertrader 3.0: point-in-time price data allow causal correlation groups, and pre-registered EQUITY MODEL variants are implemented as research (research/turtle-correlation.mjs: RAW / market-residual returns, 63 / 126 / 252 sessions, complete / average / single linkage, absolute and pair-quantile thresholds, explicit unknown policies); the binding stays blocked because the source names no measure, window or threshold (source-open) and no variant is owner-approved. Reference runs stay without groups.

rules.rule: add one unit every 1/2 N above the previous ACTUAL fill, up to the 4-unit limit
rules.derivation: N for add spacing and stops is N of the initial entry (the printed examples keep N constant); the next level is 1/2 N above the last actual fill even if that unit was stopped out since; after a unit stop-out the position takes no further adds (a re-add would be the optional Whipsaw re-entry, not implemented); the first add of a bar fills at max(open, level), later adds of the same bar at their level

rules.rule: several units may be added on the same day
rules.derivation: consequence of TUR-ADD on daily bars; no extra rule

rules.rule: each unit starts with a stop 2N below its own fill
every add raises the stops of all earlier units by 1/2 N; each unit keeps its own stop and is stopped out on its own (closes #712 finding V41-F1)
after a gapped add the units carry different stops
rules.derivation: not a separate rule: the consequence of TUR-STOPADD that the worked example TUR-CRUDE prints (27.70, 27.70, 27.70, 28.40); reproduced by a golden case

rules.rule: simultaneous signals: buy the strongest first
rules.derivation: TUR-RANKVAR (OPTIONAL) allows several normalisations; the one the source names, (close - close 3 months ago) / N with 3 months = 63 sessions at the prior close, is used; ties by security id. Without group data all simultaneous signals form one group.

rules.rule: cash account, no leverage: a unit is bought only if its full cost fits in cash; otherwise REJECT_NO_CASH (counted)
rules.derivation: futures margin has no equity analogue in a cash research account; declared adaptation (#709 VU-TUR: "Long-only-Equity-Adaptation mit Cashgrenze")
